props.gloss_en: Rava bar Yirmeya: from when does one bless over the scent? from when its column [of smoke] rises
by your reasoning, 'who brings forth bread from the earth', which one blesses -- and he has not yet eaten! rather, his intent is to eat
here too, his intent is to smell
over all incense one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
except musk, over which one blesses 'who creates kinds of spices'
[musk is excepted] for it is from a living creature
the baraita: one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods' only over the balsam of Rebbi's house, the balsam of Caesar's house, and myrtle anywhere
Rav Yehuda: over balsam oil one blesses 'who creates the oil of our land'
Rav Chisda: [that is] apart from Rav Yehuda, to whom Eretz Yisrael is dear
R' Yochanan: over balsam oil one blesses 'who creates pleasant oil'
Rav Adda bar Ahava: over this costus one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
over pressed [scented] oil one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods' (denied by Rav Adda, asserted by Rav Kahana)
over ground [scented] oil one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods' (denied by Rav Kahana, asserted by the Nehardeans)
Rav: over this jasmine (simlak) one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
Rav: over these chilfei deyama one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
Mar Zutra: what is the verse? 'and she had brought them up to the roof and hid them in the flax of the tree' (Josh 2:6)
Rav Mesharshiya: over garden narkom one blesses 'who creates fragrant woods'
Rav Mesharshiya: over [narkom] of the field, 'who creates fragrant herbs'
Rav Sheshet: over these violets one blesses 'who creates fragrant herbs'
Mar Zutra: one who smells an etrog or a quince says 'Blessed ... who gave good scent in fruits'

Rav Yehuda: one who goes out in the days of Nisan and sees trees blossoming says 'Blessed ... who left nothing lacking in His world, and created in it good creatures and good trees for people to enjoy'
Rav: whence that one blesses over scent? as it says 'let every soul praise the Lord' (Ps 150:6)
Rav: what is it that the soul enjoys and the body does not enjoy? say: that is scent
Rav: the young men of Israel are destined to give off a good scent like the Lebanon
Rav: as it says 'his branches shall spread, his beauty shall be as the olive tree, and his scent as the Lebanon' (Hos 14:7)
Rav: [the din whose source he seeks:] one blesses over scent
Rav's criterion read from the verse: 'every soul shall praise' -- the soul praises over a thing the soul enjoys and the body does not
